question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Cowardice
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Cowardice"** means lack of bravery or courage; a trait of being easily scared or avoiding danger. (कायरता)

 
 
• **Example: **His** cowardice** in the face of danger was evident when he refused to help his friend.
 
 
 
• **"Boldness" **refers to a willingness to take risks and act innovatively; confidence and courage. (साहस)
 
 
• **Example: **Her **boldness** in standing up to the bullies was commendable.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'cowardice' **is **'boldness'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Abundance **(प्रचुरता): A very large quantity of something.

 
 
• **Example:** There was an abundance of food at the festival.
 
 
 
• **Hazard **(खतरा): A danger or risk.
 
 
• **Example: **Smoking is a serious health hazard.
 
 
 
• **Vigour** (उत्साह): Physical strength and good health.
 
 
• **Example:** He worked with great vigour to complete the project.
